title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 38
description: Ten questions on Genesis 38: Judah, his sons, Tamar and the birth of Perez and Zerah.

questions.text: What was the name of the Adullamite whom Judah visited?
questions.explanation: Judah went down from his brothers and visited a certain Adullamite whose name was Hirah.

questions.text: What was the name of Judah's firstborn son?
questions.explanation: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and the next verse again calls Er Judah's firstborn.
Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh's sight, so Yahweh killed him.

answers.text: He was wicked in Yahweh's sight

questions.text: What did Judah tell Tamar to do until Shelah had grown up?
questions.explanation: Judah told Tamar to remain a widow in her father's house until Shelah was grown up, and she lived there.

answers.text: Remain a widow in her father's house
Go and work for the sheep shearers

questions.text: Where was Judah going when Tamar heard about his trip?
questions.explanation: Tamar was told that her father-in-law was going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.

answers.text: Up to Timnah to shear his sheep
Down to Egypt to buy grain
To Hebron to see his father
To Dothan to find his brothers

questions.text: What did Judah promise to send the woman he met by the road?
questions.explanation: Judah said, "I will send you a young goat from the flock."

answers.text: A young goat from the flock

questions.text: What did Tamar ask Judah to give her as a pledge?
questions.explanation: She asked for his signet, his cord and the staff in his hand, and he gave them to her.

answers.text: His ring, his robe and his sandals
His signet, his cord and his staff

questions.text: What did Judah order when he heard that Tamar was with child?
questions.explanation: When Judah was told that Tamar had played the prostitute and was with child, he said, "Bring her out, and let her be burned."

answers.text: That she be stoned at the gate
That she be brought out and burned
That she be sent away to Egypt
That she be given to Shelah at once

questions.text: What did Judah say after he recognized the signet, cord and staff?
questions.explanation: Judah acknowledged them and said, "She is more righteous than I, because I didn't give her to Shelah, my son."

questions.text: What was the name of the twin who had the scarlet thread on his hand?
questions.explanation: The midwife tied a scarlet thread on the first hand, but his brother Perez came out first; afterward the one with the scarlet thread came out and was called Zerah.
